पृत् f. An army. This word has no form, for the first five cases; accord-
ing to some it is an optional substitute for the next.

पृतना f. (-ना)
 1. An army.
 2. A small army or division consisting of
243 elephants, as many chariots, 729 horse, and 1215 foot.
 3.
Fight, encounter.
 E. पृ to fill, तनन् aff.

पृतनासाह् m. (-षाट्) INDRA.
 E. पृतना an army, सह् to bear or be equal to, ण्वि aff.
